description: Read barcodes and QR codes from an image (URL or base64): QR, Micro QR, DataMatrix, Aztec, PDF417, MaxiCode, EAN-13/8, UPC-A/E, Code 128/39/93, Codabar, ITF and DataBar. Finds every code in the picture, even rotated, small or inverted (phone photos, receipts, labels, screenshots), and returns each one's text, format, position and meaning (URL, Wi-Fi network, vCard, e-mail, phone, location, crypto payment URI, product GTIN). No code found = not charged. Paid ($0.001, x402).

formats.description: Only look for these formats (default: all)

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URI), max 8 MB. Use this or image_url

image_url.description: Public URL of the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF; max 8 MB). Use this or image_base64

name: read_barcode
title: read barcode
